svg.aria-label: Larger independently checked Python re benchmark
svg.text: How thoroughly are the faster Python re replacements tested?
10,312 unseen tasks · 10,312 separate practice tasks · CPython 3.14.6 baseline
All 12,432 earlier tasks are preserved exactly. The larger test adds 64 balanced kinds of real work.
Eight equally represented kinds of work
Which normal Python re calls are exercised?
Counts include every preserved and new task. Text, bytes, mutable buffers, compiled calls, module calls, and fresh compilation are included.
All engines must match Python before any timing
103,120/103,120 frozen checks agree · 0 failures · 2,011 byte and buffer tasks · 128 lone-surrogate tasks
13 paired trials · 4 warmups · 2,000 confidence samples · every task counts equally
